extensionDescription.message: You can find who doesn't follow you back on Instagram and unfollow them using this extension.

extensionName.message: Unfolks - Find who doesn't follow you back on Instagram!

authError.message: You need to log in to Instagram or you don't have permission. Please log in to Instagram and try again.

newUnfollowersWarning.description: Warning message when new unfollowers detected

actionBlocked.description: Shown when Instagram temporarily blocks an action (feedback_required / checkpoint)
actionBlocked.message: Instagram temporarily blocked this action. Please wait a few hours and try again.

unfollowFailed.description: Shown when Instagram rejects an unfollow for an unknown reason
unfollowFailed.message: Couldn't unfollow this account. Please try again in a moment.

accountMismatch.description: Shown when the list belongs to a different Instagram account than the one logged in
accountMismatch.message: This list belongs to another Instagram account. Please refresh the list.

scanFailed.description: Shown when Instagram returns an unexpected response during a scan
scanFailed.message: Instagram sent an unexpected response. Please refresh Instagram and try again.
